name: rd-ledger
description: R&D tax-credit evidence from your git history: a tax year's commits grouped into components, who worked on what and when, and the commits that look like experimentation as candidate evidence, each traced to its commit, in a dated CSV and markdown pack for your accountant. Hours and amounts only from figures you supply. Runs npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/rd-ledger locally; no account, no network, no LLM calls of its own. Evidence to review with your tax adviser; not tax advice.
